name: Descriptive statistics
description: Mean, median, mode, range, variance and standard deviation of a list.
solve: function solve(q){const nums=(q.replace(/(\d),(\d{3})\b/g,'$1$2').match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number);if(nums.length<2)return{answer:null,reason:'Need at least two numbers.'};const t=q.toLowerCase(),n=nums.length,s=[...nums].sort((a,b)=>a-b),sum=s.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),mean=sum/n,med=n%2?s[(n-1)/2]:(s[n/2-1]+s[n/2])/2;const cnt={};s.forEach(v=>cnt[v]=(cnt[v]||0)+1);const mx=Math.max(...Object.values(cnt));const mode=mx>1?Object.keys(cnt).filter(k=>cnt[k]===mx).map(Number):[];const sample=/\bsample\b/.test(t);const v=s.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-mean)**2,0)/(n-(sample?1:0));const r=x=>+x.toFixed(4);const all={mean:r(mean),median:r(med),mode:mode.length?mode.join(', '):'none',range:r(s[n-1]-s[0]),variance:r(v),'standard deviation':r(Math.sqrt(v))};const ask=Object.keys(all).filter(k=>t.includes(k)||(k=='mean'&&/\baverage\b/.test(t))||(k=='standard deviation'&&/std ?dev/.test(t)));const keys=ask.length?ask:Object.keys(all);return{answer:keys.map(k=>`${k} ${all[k]}`).join(', '),steps:[`Sorted: ${s.join(', ')} (n = ${n})`,`Sum = ${r(sum)}, mean = ${r(sum)} ÷ ${n} = ${r(mean)}`,`Median = ${r(med)}`,`${sample?'Sample':'Population'} variance = ${r(v)}, standard deviation = √${r(v)} = ${r(Math.sqrt(v))}`]}}
